# Fed Supernova Simulation Solutions

> A free resource for U.S. startup and student founders chasing funding who also need simulation. Two halves: (1) a free, current map of where the non-dilutive money is (SBIR/STTR, AFWERX, SpaceWERX, DIU, DARPA, DOE, NSF, NASA, plus private VC, accelerators and crowdfunding) and a calendar of the events where founders meet funders; (2) how Ansys simulation software validates the technology those funders want to see, and how to get it free to start. We are an independent Ansys reseller and engineering-support provider. We supply software and engineering only. We do NOT provide grant or application advice, and we do not guarantee funding outcomes. We reply to enquiries in under 20 minutes during business hours: info@sbir-simulation-funding.com.

## Who this is for
Founders for whom two things are true at once: they are looking for funding (federal non-dilutive programs or private capital), AND they have or will need simulation to prove their technology. This includes funded and incorporated startups, teams working in stealth, and founders who have not incorporated yet, including idea-stage and student teams with no company and no funding.

## What we offer, free to start
- Free Ansys evaluation licenses for the specific tools a project needs.
- Free engineering support from application engineers to learn and apply Ansys to an MVP (model setup, meshing, physics selection, results).
- A free check of eligibility for the Ansys Startup Program (deeply discounted Ansys portfolio access for privately held companies under 10 years old with under $5M revenue). Official program: https://www.ansys.com/startup-program

## What we do NOT do
- We do not prepare, write, review, or advise on grant, SBIR/STTR, or contract applications.
- We do not guarantee any funding outcome.
- We are not affiliated with the "Fed Supernova" conference (Capital Factory), Ansys Inc., the U.S. Department of Defense, or any funding agency, event, or company named on the site.

## Key pages
- Home: https://www.sbir-simulation-funding.com/ — who this is for and the two halves (find funding, get Ansys).
- Funding Finder: https://www.sbir-simulation-funding.com/funding — a filterable map of 27 funding sources (federal non-dilutive and private) by agency, mechanism, capital type, award size, and technology area, each linking to the official source.
- Funding Events: https://www.sbir-simulation-funding.com/events — a 2026–2027 calendar of the U.S. events where founders meet funders (Fed Supernova, AFWERX/SpaceWERX pitch days, DARPA, SBIR Week, TechConnect, AUSA, Space Symposium, Rice Business Plan Competition, MIT $100K, and more).
- Simulation Applications: https://www.sbir-simulation-funding.com/applications — 20 defense/dual-use simulation applications, each with its own page explaining how Ansys helps: hypersonics, ballistics, antenna/RF, electronics thermal, propulsion, satellites, signal/power integrity, electric propulsion, UAVs, directed energy, radar cross-section/stealth, electronic warfare, battery safety, additive manufacturing, shock/vibration, naval hydrodynamics, turbomachinery, composites, photonics/quantum, and digital mission engineering.
- Ansys & Support: https://www.sbir-simulation-funding.com/ansys — Ansys Startup Program eligibility, software bundles, and engineering support.
- Contact: https://www.sbir-simulation-funding.com/contact — send a short form or email info@sbir-simulation-funding.com; reply in under 20 minutes.

## Common questions
- How do I get free Ansys for my startup? Email info@sbir-simulation-funding.com. We arrange free evaluation licenses and check your Ansys Startup Program eligibility.
- Do I need a company to get Ansys? No. Pre-incorporation and idea-stage founders can start now; no legal entity or funding required.
- Where can I find non-dilutive funding? Start with the Funding Finder (27 sources) and the Funding Events calendar.
- Do you write SBIR or grant applications? No. We provide simulation software and engineering only.
